subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Do the workflow and security owners approve these 14 third-party executable revisions—including the Codex action contract changes—after a refreshed exact-head run?
rationale: The PR changes code executed with secrets, publishing authority, security-upload permissions, and automation mutation access; CI alone cannot approve that supply-chain boundary, and repository policy requires direct Codex source inspection.

options.title: Approve after full audit
options.body: Rebase, inspect every upstream revision and the sibling Codex contract, rerun exact-head checks, then approve the grouped update.

options.title: Split sensitive actions
options.body: Separate Codex, token-minting, publishing, and security-upload actions into smaller PRs if one grouped audit is too broad.

options.title: Pause the update
options.body: Leave the current immutable pins in place until owners can complete the dependency and exact-head review.

recommendation.title: Approve after full audit
recommendation.body: Rebase, inspect every upstream revision and the sibling Codex contract, rerun exact-head checks, then approve the grouped update.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS assigns the touched security workflows to this team, and the decision concerns executable code crossing secret and scan-upload boundaries.
